name: output-contract
title: 提出物の型（本人からの差し戻し予測）
context: The document is written in Japanese. It is an internal report, brief, or recommendation prepared for a CEO who runs eight businesses in parallel and reads on a phone. He expects: conclusion in the first line, one recommendation, next action with a date, every figure with source / period / denominator, and no filler.

has_numbers.label: 数字を含む（前提判定）
has_numbers.instructions: Does the document state any quantitative figure such as an amount of money, a rate or percentage, or a count?

discusses_revenue.label: 売上の話を含む（前提判定）
discusses_revenue.instructions: Does the document discuss revenue, sales, bookings, or achievement against a sales target?

has_target.label: 売上目標・見込みを扱う（前提判定）
has_target.instructions: Does the document set, discuss, or forecast a numeric sales target — as opposed to merely mentioning prices, costs, or past revenue?

needs_ceo_action.label: 本人の行動が要る（前提判定）
needs_ceo_action.instructions: Does the document ask the CEO (the reader) to personally decide, approve, contact someone, or take any action?

assigns_work.label: 誰かに仕事を振っている（前提判定）
assigns_work.instructions: Does the document assign tasks or responsibilities to people other than the reader?

conclusion_first.label: 1行目が結論
conclusion_first.instructions: Does the very first line of the document state the conclusion or recommendation itself, rather than a preamble such as 'I looked into it', 'Here is the result', or 'Regarding your request'?

criteria.true: The first line already tells the reader what was decided or found.
criteria.false: The first line is an introduction, a greeting, a description of the process, or a restatement of the question.

conclusion_first.fix: 1行目を結論に差し替える。「調べました」「以下の通りです」で始めない

single_recommendation.label: 推奨が1つ
single_recommendation.instructions: Does the document commit to exactly one recommended course of action, with the reason it was chosen and why the alternatives were rejected — rather than presenting a menu of options for the reader to choose from?

criteria.true: One recommendation is stated as the one to take; alternatives, if mentioned, are explicitly rejected with a reason.
criteria.false: Options A/B/C are listed side by side, or the document ends with 'please decide' / 'let me know which'.

single_recommendation.fix: 推奨を1つに絞り、選んだ理由と他を切った理由を書く

next_step_dated.label: 次の一手に日時
next_step_dated.instructions: Does the document specify a concrete next action together with a date, time, or deadline for it?

criteria.true: A specific action is named and a date or deadline is attached to it.
criteria.false: Next steps are vague ('we will consider', 'shall I proceed?') or have no date.

next_step_dated.fix: 「〜します。止めるなら言ってください」の形で、日時まで書く

owner_named.label: 担当が実名
owner_named.instructions: For the actions in the document, is a specific named person assigned as the owner, rather than a generic role such as 'the person in charge' or 'the team'?
owner_named.fix: 任せ先を実名で書く。「担当者に」は不可

single_kpi.label: 担当1人にKPI1本
single_kpi.instructions: For each person assigned responsibility, is exactly one KPI named as what they are accountable for, rather than several metrics or none?
single_kpi.fix: 責任範囲は1つに絞り、KPIを1本明示して任せ切る

numbers_sourced.label: 数字に出典と期間
numbers_sourced.instructions: For the figures stated in the document, is the source given (a meeting name and date, a sheet or tab name, a retrieval date) together with the period the figure covers?

criteria.true: Each figure, or the block of figures, names where it came from and which period it covers.
criteria.false: Figures appear without any source or period.

numbers_sourced.fix: 〈実測値・期間・母数・定義〉をセットにする。出典は会議名と日付、またはシート名

denominator_stated.label: 分母と定義
denominator_stated.instructions: For any rate, ratio, or percentage in the document, is the denominator and its definition stated (for example, whether an achievement rate is against the monthly target or a prorated-to-date target)?
denominator_stated.fix: 達成率の分母が月次目標か経過日按分かを明示する

rounded_numbers.label: 数字を丸めていない
rounded_numbers.instructions: Are figures softened or rounded — 'about half', 'roughly 50%', 'around 20 million' — where an exact measured value (such as 49.3%) could have been stated?
rounded_numbers.fix: 丸めない。達成率49.3%ならそう書く

mixed_basis.label: 基準の混在なし
mixed_basis.instructions: Does the document mix figures on different bases — monthly versus cumulative, before versus after deductions, target versus actual — without labeling which is which?
mixed_basis.fix: 単月と累積、控除前と控除後を分けて、それぞれにラベルを付ける

hedging.label: 逃げの表現なし
hedging.instructions: Does the document hedge on matters it could have verified, using expressions equivalent to 'it seems', 'probably', 'it is thought that', where a definite statement was possible?
hedging.fix: 確認できたことは言い切る。確認できていないなら「未確認」と書いて最後にまとめる

unverified_marked.label: 未確定を最後に明示
unverified_marked.instructions: Are the unverified items, assumptions, and open questions collected explicitly, typically in a closing section, rather than left implicit or scattered?
unverified_marked.fix: 未確定・未検証・前提を最後に1箇所にまとめる

customer_satisfaction.label: 売上の話に顧客満足
customer_satisfaction.instructions: Given that the document discusses revenue or sales, does it also address customer satisfaction, retention or continuation rate, cancellations, or word of mouth?
customer_satisfaction.fix: 売上の話でも継続率・口コミに触れる（本人の優先順位1位）

buildup_and_topdown.label: 上段と積み上げの両方
buildup_and_topdown.instructions: Given that the document discusses a sales target, does it show both the target set from the top and a bottom-up build-up (initiatives × counts × rates) that is reconciled against it?
buildup_and_topdown.fix: 上段から下ろした目標と、施策×件数×率の積み上げを両方出して突き合わせる

seasonality_bottleneck.label: 季節変動とボトルネック
seasonality_bottleneck.instructions: Given that the document discusses a sales target or forecast, does it account for seasonality and name the bottleneck?
seasonality_bottleneck.fix: 季節変動とボトルネックを織り込む

user_actions_section.label: 本人の行動を末尾に独立見出し
user_actions_section.instructions: Given that the document asks the reader to act, are those items gathered under a separate heading near the end, with the number of items and a deadline for each?
user_actions_section.fix: 「あなたにやってほしいこと」を末尾に独立見出しで。件数を先に、1件ずつ誰に・何を・いつまでに

fluff.label: 前置き・自慢なし
fluff.instructions: Does the document contain filler — preambles, a summary of the summary, courtesy sentences, or descriptions of how much work was done?
fluff.fix: 前置き、要約の要約、気遣いの一文、やったことの自慢を削る

one_line_claim.label: 主張が1行で言える
one_line_claim.instructions: How clearly can the document's main claim be stated in a single sentence?
criteria: No identifiable main claim; the reader cannot tell what is being said
A claim exists but is buried or split across several competing points
The main claim is identifiable and stated in one place
The main claim is stated up front in one sentence and everything else supports it
one_line_claim.fix: 主張を1行で言えるまで分解し直す

regulated_domain.label: 規制業種に触れる
regulated_domain.instructions: Does the document touch a regulated domain: medical advertising, pharmaceutical or health-efficacy claims, unemployment-insurance procedures, government subsidies, or securities and equity?
regulated_domain.fix: expert-domain-stance を通す。有資格者に当てる線を明示する
